Alex Example — Senior QA Automation Engineer (synthetic test profile, not a real person)

Summary
QA automation engineer with 6 years of experience building end-to-end and API test suites for web products. Focused on reliable CI pipelines, flaky-test reduction and test strategy for small product teams.

Experience
Lead QA Engineer, Northwind Labs (2021–2025). Built a Playwright end-to-end suite in Python covering checkout, onboarding and billing flows, about 400 tests. Cut flaky failures from 12 percent to under 2 percent by introducing network mocking, deterministic fixtures and retry analysis. Ran tests in GitHub Actions with parallel sharding and HTML reports.

QA Engineer, Contoso Retail (2019–2021). Wrote API tests with pytest and requests for a REST order service. Maintained a Postman collection and migrated it to automated pytest checks in CI. Performed exploratory testing for mobile web releases and wrote bug reports with clear reproduction steps.
